result.summary: Found duplicated restaurant cards in 'Fastest near you' plus bottom content clipping and inconsistent favorite-icon styling.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards side-by-side with the same image, same '15-25 min' badge and same '€0.90 delivery' text
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the feed data and ensure the carousel lists unique restaurants

issues.description: The second card in 'Popular right now' (pizza image with -20% badge) is cut off mid-image by the bottom tab bar with no restaurant name, rating or metadata visible and no spacing above navigation
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding and safe-area inset so list items scroll fully above the tab bar

issues.description: Favorite heart icons in 'Popular right now' are inconsistent: first card shows white outline with no background, second card shows white outline on a dark circular background
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent circular scrim/background for all favorite icons to ensure visibility and visual consistency
